formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Strategy Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute mid-unit check confirming B2.3 (mental strategies) and B2.1+B2.2 (fact families) before Day 4 introduces story problems.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative assessment distinct from lesson worksheets. Lets the teacher see which children can fluently apply mental strategies and write fact families before story-problem modelling begins.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can use a mental strategy to add and subtract within 20, and I can write the four-fact family for any sum.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use a mental strategy to add and subtract within 20, and I can write the four-fact family for any sum.
header.character_watermark: Plus and Minnie together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

prompts.prompt: Solve each fact. Write the strategy you used in the box.
prompts.visual_layout: Top half. Six fact-strategy boxes in a 2x3 grid. Each box: a fact on the left (e.g., '6+7'), a strategy bubble on the right (DOUBLE / NEAR-DOUBLE / MAKE-TEN / COUNT-ON), and an answer line.

image_placeholders.description: Six fact-strategy boxes in B&W line-art, 2-row × 3-column grid. Each box ~2.2in × 1.5in. Format per box: fact on left (e.g. '6+7' or '8+5'), four strategy bubbles to circle (DOUBLE / NEAR-DOUBLE / MAKE-TEN / COUNT-ON), an answer line below. Pre-fills: 6+7, 5+5, 8+5, 12+3, 7+8, 9+4.
image_placeholders.placement: Top half of the page; full-width.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_SIX_STRATEGY_BOXES: keywords (strategy, fact) name what the boxes ask for.

prompts.answer_key: 6+7=13 NEAR-DOUBLE. 5+5=10 DOUBLE. 8+5=13 MAKE-TEN. 12+3=15 COUNT-ON. 7+8=15 NEAR-DOUBLE (or MAKE-TEN). 9+4=13 MAKE-TEN.

prompts.prompt: Each triangle is a fact family. Write the four facts (or three, if it's a doubles triangle).
prompts.visual_layout: Middle. Three fact-family triangles in a row. Below each triangle, 4 (or 3 for doubles) equation lines.

image_placeholders.description: Three fact-family triangles in B&W line-art, in a row. Each triangle ~1.6in tall. Numbers shown: T1 (4,6,10), T2 (3,3,6 — doubles), T3 (5,7,12). Below each triangle, equation lines.
image_placeholders.placement: Middle of the page; three triangles in a row.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_THREE_TRIANGLES: keywords (triangle, facts) name what the triangles show.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling about the Adding Machine strategies? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Three faces in a horizontal row. Below each: 'GOT IT!', 'ALMOST!', 'TRY AGAIN!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row, each ~1.5in across. Smile, neutral, frown. Below each, the labels.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

prompts.answer_key: Open. Compare with prompts 1 and 2 results.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child. Score guide: 6/6 strategies correct + 3/3 fact families correct + confident self-rating = ready for Lesson 4. 4-5/6 strategies + 2/3 fact families = brief 1:1 conference. 3 or fewer strategies = small-group reteach with the double ten-frame and triangle cards before Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Adding Machine Reflection
reflection_sheet.purpose: End-of-unit metacognition. Children look back at their week of addition-and-subtraction work, rate themselves, name a favourite strategy, name a struggle, set a forward goal.
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Plus the Pup with a Junior Adding Machine Operator certificate in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Adding Machine Operator? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Three star-rating ovals. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels below.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W line-art. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars left to right. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am an Adding Machine Operator!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

options: I am an Adding Machine Operator!

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.
prompts.visual_layout: A 4-row YES/NO table. Questions: 'I learned addition facts to 10.', 'I used a mental strategy.', 'I solved a story problem.', 'I shared a collection fairly.'

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table in B&W line-art. Each row has a question label on the left and YES/NO oval bubbles on the right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE mental strategy?
prompts.visual_layout: Four strategy icons in a row: doubles (twin), near-doubles (twin+1), make-ten (ten-frame), count-on (footstep). Below each, a circle.

image_placeholders.description: Four strategy icons in a row in B&W line-art: doubles (twin), near-doubles (twin+1), make-ten (10-frame), count-on (footstep). Each ~1in × 1in with a selection bubble below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (doubles, near-doubles, make-ten, count-on) name the four strategies.

prompts.visual_layout: Three tricky-moment cards in a row: cup-hide (subtraction-as-missing-addend), tape-diagram drawing (story-problem modelling), half-share (fair-share with a leftover).

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W line-art. Card A: cup hiding counters in a ten-frame. Card B: a tape-diagram with two parts and a total. Card C: a cookie cut along a half-line on two plates. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cup, tape-diagram, half) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?
prompts.visual_layout: Three forward-goal cards: bigger sums (to 100), multi-step story problems, fractions (1/4 of a pizza).

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W line-art. Card A: a sum '50+50=?' in a thought bubble. Card B: a multi-step problem with two equations stacked. Card C: a pizza divided into 4 fourths with one fourth shaded.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (sums, story, fractions) name the three forward-goal cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the very end of Lesson 5. Allow children to take home as a self-assessment artifact. Compare each child's reflection with their summative score: high reflection + high summative = ready for next unit; mismatches signal confidence-building or remediation needs.
